Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift slate, stakeholder roster, and QBR slot

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As we discussed, Olive Platform is coming up for renewal in February and you indicated interest in formalizing the additional capacity uplift (seat and throughput) alongside a two-quarter term extension. I want to kick off the coordination so we can lock a QBR slot and get the mutual action plan in motion.

A few concrete items to start:
- Proposed timeline: internal review and pricing approval by 2027-01-10, legal/PO in week of 2027-01-22, QBR and handoff week of 2027-02-06 (flexible).
- Stakeholders: please confirm the final exec/ops list for the QBR. From our side I'll be the primary renewal lead; looping Karthik for pricing and David for SRE migration planning. Monica will handle onboarding staffing.
- Draft agenda attached (short) and a seed mutual action plan workbook (attached).

Ask: can you confirm the preferred QBR windows below and the final internal stakeholder list by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-16)?
- Option A: Tue 2027-02-07 10:00–11:30 PT
- Option B: Thu 2027-02-09 13:00–14:30 PT
- Option C: Mon 2027-02-06 16:00–17:30 PT

Notes on capacity: Karthik will propose a capacity uplift profile that preserves current latency targets while adding a 30% throughput headroom; if you have projected peak token/day estimates for Q1 we can feed that into the sizing.

Thanks — I can hop on a short call to walk the plan through if that helps.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Lead, Renewals | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- QBR preference: Option B works best for us (Thu 2027-02-09 afternoon PT).
- Stakeholders: I'll join plus Priya (Head of SRE) and our CTO, Maya Rao (copied on internal threads; not on this thread right now). Also want to include our procurement lead, Jordan Lee, once we reach terms.
- Peak estimate: current average tokens/day is ~220M, but we expect a campaign spike in January that could push peak/day to ~360M for a multi-week window. We'll confirm engineering numbers by Tuesday.

Regarding the uplift profile: we'd like to preserve current SLA for 99th pct latency and keep unit cost within ~12% of current blended rate. If the uplift pushes cost over that threshold we may need to stagger the uplift across Q1.

I'll confirm internal attendee names by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks —
Liam
Head of Platform Engineering, Olive Platform
liam.carter@oliveplatform.com | +1 (718) 555-0221

Stephanie / team —

Thanks — copying next steps from our internal sizing discussion and a couple asks for the customer before we send a formal proposal:

1) Sizing assumptions (I'll draft a recommended uplift matrix):
   - Baseline token/day: 220M (customer reported)
   - Peak (campaign): 360M for short window -> propose two-step uplift: +25% immediate reserve then +20% temporary burst on Jan campaign week(s).
2) Cost guardrails: keep blended unit cost increase <=12% relative to current billing. If the two-step approach still breaches, propose deferred burst (start Feb 15) with consumption-based buffer.
3) Ops requirements: need the customer's expected concurrent streams and average seq len to finalize batch sizing.
4) Security/compliance: David: can you confirm whether Olive needs an updated SOC2 evidence package or longer audit window? Priya (customer) flagged potential SOC2 evidence and API access logs retention policy.

I will assemble a draft commercial term sheet and upload to the HubSpot deal record by tomorrow afternoon.

-Karthik
Sr. Commercial Solutions, Redwood Inference
